# mtncloud_instance_workflow (Resource)

Runs an operational workflow on instances, as the console's Actions > Run Workflow does, for example MTN's `Create Linux User Git` or `Update Linux User Passwd`. It runs when this is created, and again on every instance whenever `workflow`, `instance_ids`, `inputs`, `secret_inputs` or `triggers` change. The apply waits for the run and fails with the workflow's own message if it fails; the next apply runs it again. A run isn't kept by MTN Cloud as an object, so it can't be imported, and destroying this undoes nothing on the instances (a user it made stays, for example).

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "deploy_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Makes a Linux user on the VM with MTN's workflow. The VM needs the MTN Cloud agent.
resource "mtncloud_instance_workflow" "deploy_user" {
  workflow     = "Create Linux User Git"
  instance_ids = [mtncloud_instance.web.id]
  inputs = {
    linuxUser  = "deploy"
    makeSudoer = "on"
  }
  # Password fields go here, so they are never shown in a plan.
  secret_inputs = {
    linuxPassword = var.deploy_password
  }
  # Change a value to run it again.
  triggers = {
    round = "1"
  }
}

output "deploy_user_status" {
  value = mtncloud_instance_workflow.deploy_user.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_ids` (Set of String) The instances to run it on, for example `[mtncloud_instance.web.id]`. Each needs the MTN Cloud agent (`install_agent`): without it the run fails.
- `workflow` (String) Name of the workflow, as in the console (Library > Automation > Workflows), for example `Create Linux User Git`. It must be an operational workflow.

### Optional

- `inputs` (Map of String) The workflow's form fields, by field name (the `fieldName` in its inputs), for example `{ linuxUser = "deploy", makeSudoer = "on" }`. Checked against the workflow's form at plan time. A password field goes in `secret_inputs`.
- `secret_inputs` (Map of String, Sensitive) Form fields that are secret, such as passwords. Never shown in plans or errors; kept in state (sensitive).
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `triggers` (Map of String) Any values: changing one runs the workflow again with the same inputs.

### Read-Only

- `execution_id` (Number) The last run's job execution ID.
- `id` (String) The first run's job execution ID.
- `status` (String) The last run's status.
- `workflow_id` (Number) The workflow's ID.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
